d: Sannata lekar aaya hai NH 24 ki ek aisi khaufnaak kahani, jahan raat ke 12:30 baje teen truck drivers ek sunsaan restaurant mein rukte hain. Restaurant poori tarah khaali tha, lekin tabhi wahan ek anjaan aurat aati hai aur kehti hai ki yeh restaurant sirf un teenon ke liye khula hai. Kuch hi der mein Irfaan ka ajeeb bartaav sabko daraane lagta hai. Aakhir kaun thi woh aurat aur us restaurant mein kya chhupa tha? Dekhiye Sannata
